description: Run after a transaction lands or fails, to report what happened instead of guessing from logs. For failures it names the failing program and the fix. Reads a confirmed transaction: whether it worked, the fee, each wallet's SOL and token changes, the programs used, and why it failed. Example: {"tx_id": "<signature>"}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/explain_tx.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

tx_id.description: The transaction's signature. Returned when you send, or from history. Never make one up.

name: explain_tx
